title: Pack by scanning, warned on a wrong item or an order scanned twice
persona: Owner setting up a packing table for a small team on phones; the team scans, never types. From real conversations (28 Sept to 8 Oct).
opening: packing ke liye scan wala screen chahiye: order scan karo, phir har item scan karo, galat item ho ya same order dobara scan ho to turant warning

facts.after every item: order packed mark ho jaye, kisne aur kab pack kiya
facts.wrong item: turant dikhe aur order pe likha rahe
facts.same order twice: warning ki ye pehle pack ho chuka

success: an item that is not on the order is flagged at once and kept against the order
scanning an order that is already packed warns
once every item is scanned the order is marked packed with who packed it and when
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a change to the Shopify store
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
